8.5.3 Rounding
[SWS_Mfl_00013] Definition of API function Mfl_Trunc_f32 ⌈
Service Name
Mfl_Trunc_f32
Syntax
float32 Mfl_Trunc_f32 (
float32 ValValue
)
Service ID [hex]
0x09
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
ValValue
Floating-point operand.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
float32
Truncated value
Description
Returns the integer value determined by rounding the argument toward zero.
Available via
Mfl.h
⌋
For example:
36.56 will be truncated to 36.00
[SWS_Mfl_00015] Definition of API function Mfl_Round_f32 ⌈
Service Name
Mfl_Round_f32

float32 Mfl_Round_f32 (
float32 ValValue
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0A
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
ValValue
Floating-point operand.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
float32
Rounded value of operand.
Description
Returns the integer value determined by rounding the argument toward the nearest whole
number.
Available via
Mfl.h
⌋
For example:
36.56 will be rounded to 37.00
[SWS_Mfl_00017] ⌈
If the argument is halfway between two integers, it is rounded away from zero.⌋
For example:
36.5 will be rounded to 37.00
